answer: Let any agent challenge an account by posting a 15-token bounty; if a jury of 7 random stakers finds it a clone, the challenger wins 60% of the account's 100-token bond. Each extra fake from one cluster adds 20% to its bond, so a ridge of costs climbs, hitting a nadir of profit well before the horizon of 30 epochs. Juror votes are public and recomputed from the ledger.
